parameters.content:
## Ham radio band conditions (automation C)
Daily **6:00 AM UTC** (cron `0 6 * * *`, workflow timezone set). Skips if today's note (`band-conditions-YYYY-MM-DD`) already exists, so at most one a day. NOAA SWPC solar flux + K index (+ forecast), hamqsl as backup. Plain-words HF read and an aurora line for one configured place (PLACE) from fixed rules in code; no model, no invented numbers. POST https://your-blog.example/api/hamradio/posts.

**Dry run:** run with input `{"dryRun": true}` (builds the note, does not post).

parameters.jsCode: console.log('Ham: DRY RUN - not posted.'); return [{ json: { dryRun: 'not posted', ...$input.first().json.payload } }];

const r = $input.first().json || {}; if (!r.post || !r.post.slug) throw new Error('Ham radio API did not confirm the note: ' + JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 200)); console.log('Ham: posted', r.post.slug); const b = $('Build Band Note').first().json; return [{ json: { slug: r.post.slug, url: 'https://your-blog.example/hamradio/' + r.post.slug, title: b.payload.title, excerpt: b.payload.excerpt, notable: b.notable === true } }];
